concordance_note: DOMAIN/MOTIF markers are the robust concordance axis (mean 85% across the reference set); literature GENE SYMBOLS are nomenclature-fragile (mean 27%) because deposited records use divergent symbols (candicidin->Mjm) or functional-only product names (A54145, pacidamycin). Express diagnostic_marker_set as domain/motif signatures; augment gene-symbol-heavy entries. | expected_marker_set holds T43-level markers for concordance_check; lit_diagnostic_genes holds the LIT gene/domain set for the hard scan; the architecture layer (class_architecture.py) covers the marker-invisible classes.
